incidents.summary: Live GIS stored the floodplain layer NAME (string) in property.floodplain, but rule property.floodplain compares to boolean true, so a mapped floodplain never produced the floodplain pathway for real addresses.
incidents.fix: property.floodplain is now Boolean(layer features); name kept in property.floodplainName; evidence label no longer says 'None returned' when a feature has no name (same fix for historic district label).
